POV: Your new coloring book is on fire🔥😣 (and available now!) Step into a world with giant pickle monsters, sneakers that turn their owners into mindless drones and where everything that can go wrong, does go wrong! Natural disasters, robot riots and giant meatball eating spaghetti monsters are an everyday thing in the most cute and cozy apocalypse coloring book for adults, kids, teens and your artistic cat savant (as long as they don’t have the rare fear of being turned into an actual loaf of bread by an evil kitty sorcerer). Sometimes when the world is falling apart around you and you just can’t take yet another tornado carrying giant great white sharks (that shoot laser beams out of their eyes), all you need is a moment of peace, relaxation and comfort to discover what matters the most. This coloring book will become your new ‘happy place’ as you find your own silver lining through each of your life’s disasters.
